notes:
The academic discipline that studies how societies produce, distribute, and consume goods and services. Unlike ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧ alone, which can refer to the economy in general, {経済学|けいざいがく} specifically denotes the scholarly field.

COMMON PATTERNS:
⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧ (economy) + ⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧ (study/discipline). The ～⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧ suffix is used to form academic discipline names.
